mods.name: 342 "Spotty" Cheetah C Mirage 2000C
mods.summary: SAAF Cheetah C 342 'Spotty' livery for the M-2000C.
mods.description: Single SAAF Cheetah C livery (airframe 342 'Spotty') for the M-2000C. Copy into `Saved Games\DCS\Liveries\M-2000C`; replace the v1.0 files if you have them.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: A-10C II US Digital Pack Grey Desert MixPix & Blue
mods.summary: Fictional US digital-camouflage liveries (grey, desert, mixed pixel, blue) for the A-10C II.
mods.description: Digital pixel camouflage livery pack for the A-10C II Tank Killer. The page gives no install path.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: A-29B Super Tucano (Community)
mods.summary: Free open-source A-29B Super Tucano turboprop light-attack aircraft module for DCS World.
mods.description: Independent community A-29B with FLIR, CCIP and its own systems; the README says it needs no other modules. Installs like other aircraft mods into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`.

releases.changelog: Minor updates for compatibility with DCS 2.9.26.23303.

mods.name: AH-6J Little Bird (Helicopter EFM Demo)
mods.summary: Open-source AH-6J Little Bird helicopter mod built as a blade-element EFM demo for DCS World.
mods.description: Flyable AH-6J with a blade-element external flight model, radios, TACAN and weapons. Place the `AH-6j` folder in `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`. The author notes it is still in development and not designed as a polished end-user mod.

releases.changelog: More accurate fuel system, selectable aux tanks, amp gauge, clock reset and fixes.

mods.name: AirWolf Mod
mods.summary: Fictional AirWolf helicopter mod built on the UH-60L mod's EFM, made standalone.
mods.description: Flyable fictional AirWolf helicopter based on Kinkkujuustovoileipä's UH-60L v1.4 EFM, modified to run standalone. Copy the `AirWolf` folder to `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\Aircraft` and the `Config` folder into `Saved Games\DCS`.

mods.name: Armed Blackhawk / Seahawk / Jayhawk / Pavehawk add-on
mods.summary: Add-on that gives the community UH-60L mod armed Black Hawk weapons and variant features.
mods.description:
Copies over the UH-60L mod folder to add armed Black Hawk attack capability; Seahawk/Jayhawk features are temporarily disabled since UH-60L v2. Requires the UH-60L mod v2 installed first.

Requires: Requires the UH-60L Black Hawk mod v2 (Kinkkujuustovoileipä); ANDR0ID weapon pack needed for all features.

mods.name: Barthek's Caucasus Redone 2022
mods.summary: Caucasus ground texture rework installed with JSGME, plus an optional snowless winter pack.
mods.description: Caucasus terrain texture mod distributed as JSGME-ready Google Drive downloads linked from the forum thread. It overwrites files in the DCS install folder through JSGME. An optional Snowless Winter / Late Autumn pack and a ReShade preset (goes in the DCS bin folder) are also offered.

mods.name: Bell 47 Flyable Helicopter (EFM)
mods.summary: Freeware flyable Bell 47 light helicopter with EFM for DCS World.
mods.description: Flyable Bell 47 with cold start, NVG, flashlight and a door gunner that fires where the pilot looks. Built for DCS 2.7; cannot land on water.

mods.name: Bort (DCS-BIOS Reference Tool)
mods.summary: Desktop UI and testing tool for browsing and testing DCS-BIOS controls.
mods.description: Bort is an Electron app that replaces the old Chrome-app DCS-BIOS reference tool, letting you look up and test DCS-BIOS controls per aircraft. It is a separate program with its own installer (Windows, Linux, macOS builds).

releases.changelog: Linux JSON loading fix, version dialog, removed Openbeta channel, control attributes and colours.

mods.name: BriefingRoom for DCS World
mods.summary: Open-source mission generator for DCS World, available as a desktop app or web version.
mods.description:
Generates DCS missions from user-chosen parameters. The desktop build needs the WebView2 Runtime and must not be placed under Program Files. A web version exists at dcs-briefingroom.co.uk.

A separate program with its own download; it isn't installed into DCS.

mods.name: C-130J-30 Super Hercules (Anubis mod)
mods.summary: Free community C-130J-30 Super Hercules transport mod for DCS World by Anubis.
mods.description: Flyable tactical airlifter with cargo and airdrop capability. Extract into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`; liveries go in `Saved Games\DCS\Liveries\Hercules`.

mods.name: CGTC - textures overhaul mod for the Caucasus map
mods.summary: Ground texture overhaul for the Caucasus map, including palette and gamma adjustments.
mods.description: Texture overhaul for the Caucasus terrain. The User Files download is a small zip with the download links and a README PDF; the mod itself is hosted elsewhere because it is too large to upload. It changes in-game files, so assume it modifies the DCS install folder.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: Civil Aircraft Mod (CAM)
mods.summary: Freeware pack of AI civil airliners and light aircraft for DCS World missions.
mods.description: Adds AI-only civil aircraft (A320, A380, 727, 737, 747, 757, Cessna 210 and liveries). Install into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`; units appear under Insurgents with the period filter off.

mods.name: Civilian Assets Pack: Nautical
mods.summary: Civilian ships including a sinking container ship, mobile sea base, Somali trawler and drivable boats.
mods.description: Civilian vessels and offshore construction, some drivable with Combined Arms. See the bundled README for install; v2.0 users can apply the separate trawler Lua fix.

mods.name: Civilian Assets Pack: Vehicles
mods.summary: Twenty civilian ground vehicles with variants plus one static object, Combined Arms compatible.
mods.description: Adds civilian cars, trucks and service vehicles listed under Ground Units > Civilian Vehicle > CAP in the Mission Editor. Place the pack in `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\tech`.

mods.name: Cold War Assets Mod
mods.summary: AI Cold War bombers and interceptors (Tu-126, Tu-128, Tu-95K, Tu-22, B-58, B-47) with their weapons.
mods.description: Adds AI aircraft and associated missiles and bombs such as Kh-20, KS-1, KSR-2/5, Kh-22, R-4 and FABs up to FAB-9000.

mods.name: Colour Grade Profile [reshade]
mods.summary: ReShade colour-grading preset for DCS.
mods.description: A single ReShade .ini preset. It needs ReShade installed for DCS.exe (DX11/12). The .ini goes in the root of the DCS install `bin-mt` (or `bin`) folder, so it modifies the install folder.

mods.name: Community A-4E-C Skyhawk
mods.summary: Free, community-built A-4E Skyhawk for DCS World, with a clickable cockpit and carrier operations.
mods.description:
A free A-4E Skyhawk module built by the Community A-4E-C team. It installs into **Saved Games**, so it does not affect the multiplayer integrity check.

The download is large (about 1 GB).

mods.name: Community JAS-39C Gripen
mods.summary: Community-built flyable Saab JAS-39C Gripen for DCS World with A/A and A/G variants.
mods.description:
Open community mod adding the JAS-39C Gripen with its own cockpit, liveries and weapons. Copy the `Mods` folder from the archive into `Saved Games\DCS`. The A/A variants (F-15C / Su-33 based) need Flaming Cliffs 3; the A/G variant (Su-25T avionics) does not.

Requires: A/A BVR (F-15C based) and A/A WVR (Su-33 based) variants require Flaming Cliffs 3; the A/G variant works without it.

authors.name: Community JAS-39 team (Whisky Actual et al.)

releases.changelog: Adds RWR on HUD, basic nav system, HMD brightness; fixes HMD, GBU drops and an MP crash.

mods.name: Community PTO Pack
mods.summary: Pacific Theatre WWII pack with Japanese and US ships, AI aircraft, weapons and a Saipan mission.
mods.description: Adds AI aircraft (TBM-3, A6M5, B5N, D3A1, SB2C) and ships (Fletcher, Iowa, Zuikaku, Hiryu, Akizuki, I-58 submarine, oilers, cargo) with custom shells and torpedoes. Extract to `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\Tech\Community PTO Pack`. Breaks integrity check.
requires_modules: WWII Assets Pack (for the Saipan sandbox mission)

mods.name: CopterLife Mod Pack
mods.summary: Civilian vehicles, emergency units with light bars, ships, cargo and statics prefixed CMP.
mods.description: Ground vehicles, emergency vehicles with alarm-state lights, two sinking tankers, cargo and static objects, plus a showcase mission. Drop the folder in `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\tech`.

mods.name: CSAR Script
mods.summary: Simplified combat search and rescue script: ejected pilots must be picked up and returned to a MASH, airfield or FARP.
mods.description:
Loaded inside a mission with a DO SCRIPT trigger after MIST. By default a crashed aircraft's slot stays disabled until its ejected pilot is rescued. Optional slot blocking needs csarSlotBlockGameGUI.lua placed in the DCS Scripts folder.

Requires: Requires MIST 4.0.57 or above; beacon.ogg needed for ADF homing.

mods.name: CTLD - Complete Troops and Logistics Deployment
mods.summary: Lua script for troop transport, crate-based unit building, FOBs, radio beacons and JTAC auto-lasing.
mods.description:
Loaded inside a mission with DO SCRIPT triggers after MIST. Adds helicopter and C-130 troop/vehicle transport, crate logistics, FOB construction, beacons and JTAC automation. Originally by Ciribob, now maintained by Zip and the VEAF team.

Requires: Requires MIST loaded first; beacon.ogg/beaconsilent.ogg sound files needed for beacons; optional CTLD-i18n.lua and DCS-SimpleTextToSpeech.

releases.changelog: ASC C-130J support and multiple fixes

mods.name: DCE dynamic campaign RAF over Caucasus
mods.summary: Dynamic Campaign Engine (DCE) campaign for the AV-8B in RAF service on the Caucasus map.
mods.description: DCE campaign for the AV-8B. The `EN` folder goes into `Mods\aircraft\AV8BNA\Missions` in the DCS install folder, and a DCE mission-script mod must be enabled with OvGME (re-enable after each DCS update).

mods.name: DCS Brazilian Navy
mods.summary: AI ship pack with Brazilian Navy vessels including NAM Atlantico, Niteroi and Greenhalgh class frigates.
mods.description: Adds the A-140 Atlantico carrier, Niteroi and Greenhalgh class frigates, Amazonas/Grajau/Macae patrol ships, the Bahia landing ship and more. Extract into `Saved Games\DCS`. Removing ships from older versions can corrupt missions that use them.

releases.changelog: Niteroi class gained Exocet, Aspide and Bofors 40mm; SH-60B livery added; NAM Atlantico reworked.

mods.name: DCS Input Command Injector (Quaggles)
mods.summary: Hook mod that lets you add custom input commands from your Saved Games folder instead of editing each aircraft's game files.
mods.description: Lets you add custom keybinds to any module by putting command files in `Saved Games\DCS\InputCommands`. Release 1.0.14 replaces `Scripts\Input\Data.lua` in the DCS install folder; Hardpoint backs up the original and can re-apply the mod after a DCS update.

releases.changelog: Updated for DCS 2.9.26.23111.1 Data.lua changes; strongly recommended, older versions can leave the controls page in a bugged state.

mods.name: DCS Liberation
mods.summary: Turn-based single-player or co-op dynamic campaign generator for DCS World.
mods.description: DCS Liberation manages a persistent campaign and generates DCS missions turn by turn. It is a separate program distributed as a zip you extract and run.

releases.changelog: DCS 2.9.27 support (F-100D, F-14A Export), Kola and Cold War Germany maps; saves from 14.x not compatible.

mods.name: DCS Olympus
mods.summary: Real-time web map interface for spawning, controlling and tasking units on a DCS server, RTS-style.
mods.description: Installed with its own manager (installer.bat) that adds Olympus to DCS instances; consists of a DLL loaded by DCS and a web server. Server hosts need autoexec.cfg API permissions; clients need no mods.

mods.name: DCS Retribution
mods.summary: Dynamic campaign mission generator for DCS World, forked from DCS Liberation.
mods.description: Generates DCS missions from a persistent dynamic campaign, with extra campaign features and mod-aircraft support. It is a separate program distributed as a zip you extract and run.

releases.changelog: Invisible/neutral FOBs, influence zones, DCS 2.9.20 support incl. MiG-29A, MOOSE base plugin, mod updates and fixes.

mods.name: DCS Scratchpad
mods.summary: Resizable, movable in-game notepad for DCS for quick persistent notes, especially useful in VR.
mods.description: Adds an in-game scratchpad window for persistent notes (coordinates, frequencies, etc.), handy in VR where you cannot use a paper kneeboard.

releases.changelog: Fix creation of first page if there is none.

mods.name: DCS TheWay
mods.summary: Imports waypoints picked on the DCS F10 map into the aircraft's navigation system, like a data cartridge.
mods.description: TheWay transfers waypoints selected on the F10 map into many DCS modules' nav systems; multiplayer needs the server to allow player exports. It is a separate program with its own installer plus a Scripts folder and Export.lua line.

releases.changelog: OH-58 Kiowa support.

mods.name: DCS Updater / Launcher GUI Utility (SkateZilla)
mods.summary: Windows GUI for launching DCS with options and running the DCS updater to update, repair or manage modules.
mods.description: A community GUI that launches DCS with switches and manages builds, modules, graphics presets, server options and updater tasks. It is a separate program downloaded from the ED Forums thread.

mods.name: DCS-BIOS (Skunkworks)
mods.summary: Export.lua script that lets external hardware and software read and operate the clickable cockpits of DCS aircraft.
mods.description:
DCS-BIOS is an `Export.lua` script that connects home cockpit hardware (e.g. Arduino panels) and software to the clickable cockpit of DCS aircraft. This is the DCS-Skunkworks continuation of the original, no longer updated, DCS-BIOS.

After installing, add this line to `Saved Games\DCS\Scripts\Export.lua` (create the file if it doesn't exist): `dofile(lfs.writedir()..[[Scripts\DCS-BIOS\BIOS.lua]])`. Hardpoint doesn't edit Export.lua because other tools share it.

mods.name: DCS-gRPC
mods.summary: gRPC server for DCS that lets external programs read mission data and send commands to a running mission.
mods.description:
A DCS gRPC server written in Rust: network clients can get data out of DCS and send commands into a running mission. Mainly used by server operators and tool developers.

After installing, DCS-gRPC also needs a manual change to `Scripts\MissionScripting.lua` in the DCS install folder; see its README.

releases.changelog: Land/Takeoff events added after ED change in 2.9.6.

mods.name: DCS-SimpleTextToSpeech (STTS)
mods.summary: Lua helper that speaks text or plays MP3/OGG files over SRS radio frequencies from mission scripts.
mods.description:
Loaded inside a mission with DO SCRIPT or DO SCRIPT FILE, then called via `STTS.TextToSpeech(...)` and `STTS.PlayMP3(...)`. Uses SRS External Audio, so the SRS server must run on the mission host.

Requires: Requires SRS 1.9.6.0+ on the same machine and a desanitized MissionScripting.lua (reapply after each DCS update). Optional Google TTS credentials.

mods.name: DCS: World - Jet Sound Mod
mods.summary: Replaces the distant jet noise (PlaneFarNoise) sound for all aircraft.
mods.description: Edits the PlaneFarNoise sound used by all aircraft. The page gives no install path.

mods.name: DCSFlightpanels
mods.summary: Drives Saitek/Logitech flight panels and Stream Decks for DCS, via DCS-BIOS or key emulation.
mods.description: Supports Saitek/Logitech switch, multi, radio, TPM and BIP panels plus Elgato Stream Deck models, mapping them to DCS controls via DCS-BIOS or keyboard emulation. It is a separate program distributed as a zip.

releases.changelog: Add support for CH-47 Chinook.

mods.name: DCSServerBot
mods.summary: Standalone server-management bot for DCS with monitoring, auto-restart, statistics and optional Discord integration.
mods.description:
Standalone Python application run alongside DCS servers (install.cmd / run.cmd), not loaded in missions. Provides monitoring, player/server stats, tournaments and plugins for SRS, LotAtc and Tacview; works with or without Discord.

Requires: Requires Python 3.11-3.14, PostgreSQL, optional Git; Discord bot token for the Discord version; modifies MissionScripting.lua.

mods.name: DCT - Dynamic Campaign Tools
mods.summary: Mission scripting framework for large persistent multiplayer campaigns built from editor templates and config files.
mods.description:
Distributed as a zip extracted into Saved Games\DCS; missions then use the framework to spawn templated theaters with tickets, per-faction IADS and persistent state across restarts.

After installing, DCT also needs `Scripts\MissionScripting.lua` in the DCS install folder changed to allow file and network access for missions. That lowers DCS's mission sandboxing; see the DCT documentation.

Requires: Requires removing os/io/lfs/require/package sanitization in MissionScripting.lua.

releases.changelog: dcs: fix broken dead events.

mods.name: DML - Dynamic Mission Library
mods.summary: Mission-building toolbox whose modules are configured through Mission Editor trigger-zone attributes, no Lua needed.
mods.description: Modules are loaded inside a mission and read attributes placed on trigger zones (spawners, cloners, CSAR, civil traffic, persistence and more). Ships with a PDF manual and demo missions. The repository is marked discontinued.

releases.changelog: Build 20250717 per forum thread; repo later marked discontinued (last commit 2026-06-04).

mods.name: EWRS - Early Warning Radar Script
mods.summary: Sends BRA and bogey-dope text calls to players based on what friendly in-game radars actually detect.
mods.description:
Loaded inside a mission with DO SCRIPT FILE after MIST. Uses DCS radar detection so terrain masking applies; players set reference (bullseye or own aircraft) and units via the F10 menu.

Requires: Requires MIST loaded before EWRS.lua.

releases.changelog: Fixed maxThreatDisplay bug; added C101-CC and SA342 Mistral.

mods.name: F-15C Golden Eagle Upgrade (Spino)
mods.summary: Freeware upgraded F-15C variant with AESA radar stand-in and AIM-9X support.
mods.description:
Adds an upgraded F-15C (APG-63v3 stand-in, native AIM-9X). Copy into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`. With the F-15EX mod installed it also gains extra AIM-120 variants, AIM-260A and MAKO.

Requires: F-15EX Eagle II mod (Spino) optional, for extra weapons.

mods.name: F-15EX Eagle II (Spino)
mods.summary: Freeware F-15EX Eagle II mod using the F-15C cockpit and PFM with expanded weapons loadout.
mods.description: Adds a flyable F-15EX with modernised radar/weapons and up to 12 air-to-air missiles, built on the F-15C cockpit and flight model. Listed for DCS 2.9.

mods.name: F-15J Eagle (Spino)
mods.summary: Freeware JASDF F-15J Eagle variant with Japanese missiles and liveries.
mods.description: JASDF F-15J based on the author's F-15C Golden Eagle mod, with AAM-3/4/5 missiles and JASDF liveries. Listed for DCS 2.9; download is hosted on MediaFire.

mods.name: F-16 Sound Mod (Pilot)
mods.summary: Replacement cockpit sounds for the F-16C Viper (Beyaz Kartallar sound mod).
mods.description: F-16C cockpit sound replacement. Copy the Sound folder into `Saved Games\DCS\Sounds\Effects\Aircrafts\Cockpits`. It does not touch the DCS install folder.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: F-16C Block 50 USAF Squadrons Skin Pack
mods.summary: USAF F-16C Block 50 squadron liveries with improved default textures, by Texac.
mods.description: USAF squadron liveries for the F-16C. The User Files download is only a README; the textures (Fighting_Falcon_Improved_Textures.zip) come from a MEGA link inside the PDF. Installs via JSGME or manually into `CoreMods\aircraft\F-16C\Liveries\F-16C_50` in the DCS install folder.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: F/A-18C - 64th Aggressor Squadron Skin pack

mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.description: VFA-136 squadron livery set for the F/A-18C. It needs the bundled 'VFA-136 Shared' texture folder, and the author recommends deleting older versions first. The page gives no install path.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: F/A-18C Syrian Civil War Campaign
mods.summary: Free single-player F/A-18C campaign set in the Syrian Civil War, using the Supercarrier.
mods.description: Single-player campaign. Unzip and copy the folder into `Saved Games\DCS\Missions\Campaigns\En\`.

mods.name: F15 Audio Pack

mods.description: F-15C sound replacement pack. Place the Sounds folder in `Saved Games\DCS`. It does not touch the DCS install folder.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: F16C Viper Formation Trainer
mods.summary: Three F-16C formation-flying training missions: beginner, advanced and night, on the Caucasus map.
mods.description: Small training mission pack for the F-16C on the Caucasus map. The page gives no install path; missions normally go in `Saved Games\DCS\Missions`.

releases.changelog: Added a third mission.

mods.name: Goldeneye Photo Recon Script
mods.summary: Mission script simulating tactical photo reconnaissance with per-aircraft camera parameters and F10 map markers.
mods.description: Loaded inside a mission. Derived from Yink's recon.lua for the Enigma Cold War server; adds aircraft such as F-14, F-5E, MB-339 and F-4E, status markers and BDA re-photography.

releases.changelog: Fix for DCS 2.9.6.58056.

mods.name: Grinnelli Designs F-22A Raptor
mods.summary: Community F-22A Raptor mod with thrust-vectoring EFM and interactive cockpit, relying on F-15C avionics.
mods.description:
Flyable F-22A with EFM, 6-DoF clickable cockpit, PBR textures and a paint kit. Needs DCS F-15C or Flaming Cliffs 3, and `load_immediately = true` added to `Mods/aircraft/F-15C/entry.lua` (this breaks the integrity check).

Needs the F-15C (or Flaming Cliffs 3) and a manual edit to the F-15C's `entry.lua`, which breaks the multiplayer integrity check. Follow the author's instructions on the release page.

Requires: Requires editing the official F-15C entry.lua (load_immediately = true); fails DCS integrity check.

releases.changelog: LERX vapor, IRST pod, removable pylons, ground-attack role, Mako ARM, FM and gear tuning, bug fixes.

mods.name: Helios Virtual Cockpit
mods.summary: Builds virtual cockpit panels on touchscreens and extra monitors, driven by DCS exports.
mods.description: Helios lets you lay out gauges, switches and exported displays on secondary or touch screens for DCS aircraft. It is a separate program with its own installer.

authors.name: Helios Virtual Cockpit community (BlueFinBima and contributors)

releases.changelog: Helios 1.6.618: mostly bug fixes, adds AH-6J 1.1 community mod interface, F-16 CMDS patch, memory leak fix.

mods.name: High Digit SAMs
mods.summary: Community pack adding modern Russian, Chinese and European SAM systems and MANPADS as AI units.
mods.description:
Adds S-300PMU-1/PMU-2, S-300V/VM, Buk-M1-2, SAMP/T, extra S-75/S-125/HQ-2 missiles, SA-7/14/24 MANPADS and a Polyana-D4M1 C2 vehicle. Copy the `Mods` folder into `Saved Games\DCS` (or use OVGME). All multiplayer participants need the mod.

Requires: None required; Skynet IADS script is optional for IADS behaviour.

releases.changelog: Update for DCS 2.9.6, added SAMP/T and SA-7, improved S-300 guidance.

mods.name: Hound ELINT
mods.summary: Mission script that triangulates enemy radar emitters from ELINT platforms and reports them via map markers and voice.
mods.description:
Loaded inside a mission with DO SCRIPT FILE (HoundElint.lua), then configured in Lua by adding ELINT platforms and calling `systemOn()`. Optional voice output via HoundTTS or STTS.

Requires: No external dependencies since v0.4.1; optional TTS via DCS-SimpleTextToSpeech or HoundTTS.

mods.name: Jackal's Hunt Multiplayer PvE Mission
mods.summary: Persistent multiplayer PvE mission on the Syria map built with DML, MOOSE, EWRS and SPGG.
mods.description: Multiplayer PvE `.miz` for the Syria map with many flyable aircraft, including the F-4E. It needs the Hercules and community A-4E-C mods. Persistence needs `MissionScripting.lua` edited in the DCS install folder (io/lfs desanitised).
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: JF-17 AC Inspired Sound Mod + New Engine Sounds
mods.summary: Ace Combat-style voice warnings (ENG/JPN/SWE) and new RD-93 engine sounds for the JF-17.
mods.description: Replaces the JF-17 voice warnings and optionally the engine sounds. The author says to extract the `Mods` and `CoreMods` folders into the base DCS install folder, not Saved Games.

mods.name: M2000C -DYNAMIC SOUND- Mod
mods.summary: Reworked dynamic engine and environment sounds for the M-2000C.
mods.description: Sound overhaul for the M-2000C. The author recommends installing with JSGME, which implies the DCS install folder. The page does not state the exact target.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: Massun92's Asset Pack
mods.summary: Animated modular ground crew and an M151A2 scout vehicle with liveries.
mods.description: Adds the M92_GroundCrew01 animated personnel with equipment and clothing options, and a Scout M151A2 with animated driver. Ground crew must be placed as Personnel (not statics) and needs triggers for animations.

mods.name: Mi-28NE Havoc (freebirddz)
mods.summary: Early work-in-progress Mi-28NE attack helicopter mod that borrows the Ka-50 cockpit and EFM.
mods.description: Flyable Mi-28NE (v1.0, WIP). Unzip into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`. Requires the official Ka-50 III module because it uses its cockpit and flight model.

mods.name: MIM-14 Nike Hercules SAM
mods.summary: Adds a basic MIM-14 Nike Hercules SAM site with launchers, radars and control trailers.
mods.description: Custom models for MIM-14B/C launchers (static, raised), HIPAR/LOPAR and tracking radars and site structures; flight model based on the stock SA-5. Extract `Nike_Hercules` into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\tech`.

releases.changelog: Adds new covered tracking radars.

mods.name: Minky's Simple Sandbox 3.0: Syria
mods.summary: Syria sandbox mission for air-to-air and air-to-ground practice in fixed- and rotary-wing aircraft.
mods.description: Single `.miz` training sandbox on the Syria map. The A-4E-C and UH-60L mods are optional. The page gives no install path; missions normally go in `Saved Games\DCS\Missions`.

releases.changelog: Changelog lists a 6/11/2025 update adding OH-58, CH-47 and F-4E spawns.

mods.name: Mirage 2000 - Atlas Cheetah C
mods.summary: SAAF Atlas Cheetah C liveries for the M-2000C, with variants for the three SAAF roundels.
mods.description: South African Air Force Cheetah C style liveries for the DCS M-2000C. The 26/03/24 update fixed roundel orientation and added liveries with the three SAAF roundels. The page gives no install path; liveries normally go in `Saved Games\DCS\Liveries\M-2000C`.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

releases.changelog: Corrected roundel orientation; added three liveries with the existing SAAF roundels.

mods.name: Mirage F-1CZ, South African Air Force low viz pack
mods.summary: South African Air Force low-visibility F-1CZ liveries for the Aerges Mirage F1, in two download parts.
mods.description: SAAF low-viz livery pack for the Mirage F1 (F1CE folder). Copy the extracted files into `Saved Games\DCS\Liveries\Mirage-F1CE` (the author also gives a CoreMods path as an option). Part 2 (https://files.digitalcombatsimulator.com/en/files/3329502/, 95.3 MB) must be installed together with Part 1.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: MIST (Mission Scripting Tools)
mods.summary: Long-standing Lua helper library for DCS mission scripting: spawning, messaging, unit tables and more.
mods.description:
A general-purpose scripting library that many missions and other scripts build on.

Loaded **inside a mission**. The release is distributed as a `.rar`, so download it from the release page and extract it with 7-Zip.

mods.name: MOOSE
mods.summary: Mission Object Oriented Scripting Environment: a large Lua framework for building dynamic DCS missions.
mods.description:
An object-oriented Lua framework for mission designers, covering AI tasking, air traffic, CSAR, ranges, carrier operations and much more.

Loaded **inside a mission**, so there is nothing to install into DCS. Download `Moose.lua` from the release page.

mods.name: Navy Equipment
mods.summary: Static carrier and airfield equipment: IFOLS, tow tractors, ammo trailers, GPU, forklift and deck crew.
mods.description: Adds IFOLS, MD-3 tow tractors, towbars, holdback bar, FCLP lights, GTR-18 Smokey Sam, MHU-191 trailer, GPU, A-10 ammo loader, forklift and static deck crew; placeable on carriers. Extract to `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\tech`. Marked ready for DCS 2.7.

mods.name: OpenKneeboard
mods.summary: Open-source in-game kneeboard overlay for VR and flat-screen flight sims, including DCS.
mods.description: Shows PDFs, images, DCS mission briefings and other content as a kneeboard overlay inside the sim. It is a separate program with its own MSI installer.

releases.changelog: Fixes a crash when Windows has missing or incomplete support for the current timezone.

mods.name: Red Flag Training Missions - F-16C
mods.summary: Red Flag-style F-16C training missions over the Nevada Test and Training Range.
mods.description: F-16C training mission pack set around Nellis AFB / NTTR. The page gives no install path.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: Reshade VR Enhancer Mod (VREM)
mods.summary: ReShade add-on that improves visual clarity in VR, with NVG and cockpit tweaks.
mods.description: ReShade add-on for VR. Copy its `bin` and `bin-mt` folders into the DCS install directory, which adds an addon file and a `shaderreplace` folder beside DCS.exe. It needs ReShade with full add-on support. JSGME/OVGME compatible.

mods.name: Saab SK 60 Trainer (BAAS Dynamics)
mods.summary: Free community Saab 105 / SK 60 jet trainer mod for DCS World with EFM.
mods.description: Flyable Swedish SK 60 trainer with rebuilt 3D model, KNS-81 nav, radios and custom sounds (v2.x). Installs like any aircraft mod into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`.

releases.changelog: Canopy, visor and gunsight fixes; tinted visor option; gunsight mountable via Mission Editor.

mods.name: Sailships & Props Library
mods.summary: Two historic sailing ships plus a shipwreck, rowboat and small props, with a demo mission.
mods.description: High-poly PBR sailships (furled and hoisted sails), shipwreck, rowboat, crates, barrel and treasure chest, placed as vessels and structures. Extract directly into `Saved Games\DCS` ("extract here"). Works on any map; DCS 2.9.
mods.license: Freeware, unlimited distribution; models under Creative Commons

mods.name: SH-3 Sea King AI Mod
mods.summary: AI-only SH-3G/SH-3H Sea King naval helicopter mod for DCS World.
mods.description: Adds AI SH-3G and SH-3H Sea King helicopters for missions, with a paint kit. Downloads are on Mega via the ED forum thread.

mods.name: Simple Slot Block
mods.summary: Server-side GameGUI script that lets missions open, block or kick player slots using user flags.
mods.description: Server hook (SimpleSlotBlockGameGUI.lua) installed on the server, not in the mission. Missions enable it by setting flag `SSB` to 100 and control each slot through a flag named after the group.

releases.changelog: Version string from ssb.version in the script; date is last commit.

mods.name: SimpleRadio Standalone (SRS)
mods.summary: Standalone voice radio client and server that integrates with DCS clickable cockpits and FC3 aircraft.
mods.description: SRS simulates aircraft radios for multiplayer voice comms, tied to the in-cockpit radio controls. It is a separate program with its own installer (and an auto-updater); a Linux command-line server is also published.

releases.changelog: Requires .NET 10; adds LA-7, F-14B (U), F-100D support, VR-compatible overlay, NAT improvements, new UDP commands.

mods.name: Skynet IADS
mods.summary: Mission-scripting library that makes SAM sites behave as a networked integrated air defence system.
mods.description:
A Lua library for mission makers. Air defence sites are linked through early-warning radars and command centres, and react as a network rather than individually.

This is loaded **inside a mission** (Do Script File), so there is nothing to install into DCS. Download it from the release page.

releases.changelog: Added C-RAM Centurion Phalanx.

mods.name: Slmod
mods.summary: Server-side multiplayer mod adding admin tools, stats tracking and extra mission-scripting functions.
mods.description: Server hook: the repo's Scripts folder is extracted into Saved Games\DCS (Hooks\slmodGameGUI.lua plus net\Slmod files). Server-only; clients do not need it and it does not run in single player.

releases.changelog: Hotfix for DCS 2.7.11 AH-64 release (merged from develop).

mods.name: South Carolina National Guard skinpack (AH-64D)
mods.summary: South Carolina Army National Guard liveries for the AH-64D.
mods.description: Four South Carolina National Guard liveries for the AH-64D. The author's instructions place the four zips in `CoreMods\aircraft\AH-64D\Liveries\AH-64D_BLK_II` in the DCS install folder.
mods.license: Freeware - Free version, Do Not Redistribute

mods.name: Splash Damage Script
mods.summary: Mission script that adds blast and splash damage effects to weapon impacts beyond the default DCS model.
mods.description: Loaded inside a mission with a Mission Start trigger and DO SCRIPT FILE. The .lua is copied into the .miz, so re-add it after changing settings. Several variants (Basic, Standard, Standard with ground ordnance) are provided.

releases.changelog: Repo master contains Splash_Damage_3.4.7_*.lua files.

mods.name: Su-30MK Community Mod
mods.summary: Community Su-30MK/SM family multirole fighter mod for DCS World with custom EFM.
mods.description:
Flyable Su-30 variants with a custom EFM, distributed via Google Drive links in the ED forum thread. An optional CWS add-on makes it standalone; without it some variants rely on Flaming Cliffs aircraft.

Requires: Optional CWS add-on (separate download) for standalone weapon systems; without CWS the BVR variant reportedly needs FC3/Su-33.

mods.name: Su-35S (Codename Community)
mods.summary: Open-beta community Su-35S Flanker-E fighter mod for DCS World.
mods.description:
Flyable Su-35S in open beta, distributed through Google Drive mirrors on the ED forum. Remove any old version before installing; the CWS weapon-system add-on is a separate GitLab download.

Requires: Optional CWS add-on from https://gitlab.com/codenameflanker/su-35_cws, copied over the mod folder.

mods.name: TeTeT's Vietnam War Vessels
mods.summary: Large Vietnam-era pack of US Navy ships, riverine craft, AI aircraft and ground assets.
mods.description:
Includes Essex-class carriers, CVAN-65 Enterprise, USS New Jersey, destroyers and frigates, PBR and Tango river boats, junks, sampans, AI aircraft such as the F-8 and A-1, and base buildings. Place the `Mods` folder in `Saved Games\DCS`; delete old `Mods/tech` and `Mods/aircraft` folders before upgrading.

Requires: Some ships (Maddox, The Sullivans) moved to the separate Cold War Vessels release.

releases.changelog: Adds AOE-1 USS Sacramento and unit payloads; hitpoint rebalance; fleet ship and river boat updates.

mods.name: UH-60L Black Hawk
mods.summary: Free community UH-60L Black Hawk utility helicopter mod for DCS World.
mods.description: Flyable UH-60L with its own flight model. Version 2.0 and its guide are distributed free via a Patreon post; the older v1.x builds on GitHub are marked deprecated.

mods.name: VAICOM Community Edition
mods.summary: Free voice-control add-on for VoiceAttack that operates DCS radio and AI communication menus by speech.
mods.description: VAICOM lets you issue DCS comms commands (ATC, wingmen, AWACS, AIRIO, etc.) by voice instead of the comms menu; the community edition is 100% free. It is a separate program (MSI or zip) that runs as a VoiceAttack plugin.

releases.changelog: OKB Out reliability and AID connection, AH-64D George commands, TX-Link rework, F-14 AIRIO improvements.

mods.name: VEAF Mission Creation Tools
mods.summary: VEAF's Lua mission framework plus a CLI that builds .miz files from version-controlled sources.
mods.description: The runtime Lua modules are loaded inside missions (spawning via F10 markers, CAS/convoy/QRA missions, radio menus). The `veaf-tools` CLI extracts and rebuilds .miz files and injects weather, waypoints and presets.

releases.changelog: Open Training v6 release: Falklands support, WW2 units for CAS, Normandy/Sinai parking data, FARP/convoy/QRA changes.

mods.name: VNAO T-45C Goshawk
mods.summary: Free carrier-capable T-45C Goshawk naval jet trainer mod by Virtual Naval Air Operations.
mods.description: Flyable US Navy T-45C trainer with carrier operations. Download link (MediaFire) is in the official ED forum thread; a livery paint kit is on ED User Files.

releases.changelog: SRS script removed from the package since T-45 support is now in SRS.

mods.name: ZALA Lancet Loitering Munition
mods.summary: Lancet loitering munition usable by AI or flown by a player, with animated surfaces and camera gimbal.
mods.description: Adds a Lancet loitering munition with custom textures, moving control surfaces, swivelling camera and network sync. Delete any old `Lancet` folder, then extract into `Saved Games\DCS\Mods\aircraft`.

releases.changelog: Smooth control-surface animation, working gimbal and propeller in both modes, network sync.
